high_level_description: This image captures a serene and tranquil sky scene during what appears to be either dawn or dusk. The sky is a gradient of dark blue at the top, transitioning into a lighter shade as it meets the horizon. Below the horizon, there is a layer of clouds that are illuminated with warm, orange and pink hues, suggesting the presence of the sun just below the frame, out of view. In the upper part of the image, there is a crescent moon positioned towards the left side, adding a celestial element to the scene. To the left of the moon, there is a small, bright white dot, which could be a distant star
